gate.check.title: Gate check
gate.approval.title: Approval
gate.approval.none: No added or modified elements to approve.
gate.approval.noApprovers: No stakeholder in the model can approve.
gate.approval.writing: Writing: the server runs the full gate check first, which can take tens of seconds. You cannot submit again meanwhile.
gate.approval.alreadyApproved: The branch tip is already an approval commit ({{stage}}). Approving again writes a second approval record on top of it, which the merge exemption does not allow and which needs a fresh review.
gate.approval.progressUnknown: Could not read the approval progress, so it is unknown whether the branch tip is already approved.
gate.approval.confirmRepeat: I confirm writing another record on this branch
gate.approval.gateFailed: The gate check failed, so this commit can only be rejected.
gate.approval.duplicate: The same record already exists ({{record}}, commit {{commit}}); nothing new was written.
gate.approval.staleHead: The branch has new commits. Reload this page to see the new diff before approving.
section.aiActivity.gateNeedsServer: The gate page needs the model server (VITE_AISEP_MCP_URL).
section.gates.branchMarksUnknown: Could not read the approvals on {{branches}}: elements already approved there may not be marked.
gate.approval.notApprovableFailed: Could not check which elements can be approved, so nothing is prefilled: {{message}}
gate.progress.title: Approval progress
gate.progress.fetchNote: Read from Git on the model server's repository, checked every 15 seconds. The server never fetches: “Pushed” and “Merged” follow origin as of the last git fetch there.
